dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: So, Xingqiu... Uh, d—do you, um, go on inspiration walks often, or...?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: I do. I always get bored when I'm cooped up at home, so I head out for a stroll.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Life gets busy. You have to steal a moment of leisure when you can.
